_title: Fishing Diary: Ocean Legends – Net Cannon Fishing Game
_description: Cast nets from your cannon and catch 150+ species! 40 legendary weapons, 20 ocean zones, 200 depths, epic bosses and pets. Plays offline. A free fishing game for Android.
_keywords: fishing diary, ocean legends, fishing game, net fishing game, fish catching game, offline fishing game, free android game
hero_lead: Cast nets from your cannon, catch schools of fish rushing in from both sides and dive into the ocean depths. 40 legendary weapons, 20 magical zones, 200 depths, epic bosses and 150+ species are waiting for you.
hero_icon_alt: Fishing Diary: Ocean Legends app icon
game_desc: Aim your cannon, cast your net and dive a little deeper with every catch.
g_1_d: From the Net Ball and Harpoon to the Black Hole, Poseidon's Wrath and the Eternity Ball, every weapon has its own power, and you can level up your cannon endlessly.
g_2_d: Sunny Lagoon, Coral Reef, Kelp Forest, Lost Atlantis, Cosmic Sea and more. Each of the 20 zones has 10 depths and its own creatures, music and boss.
g_3_d: Fill the progress bar, catch the guardian before time runs out and venture deeper. King Turtle, Great White, Ghost Kraken and Leviathan are waiting for you.
g_4_d: Dolphins, Pelicans, Mini Subs and Dragon Hatchlings fish for you. Turn the tide with Freeze Time, Gold Rain, Lightning Storm and Giant Net.
feat_desc: Simple taps, endless depth: cast, collect, upgrade.
f_1_d: Catch every species in normal, shiny, golden, rainbow and cosmic colors. Fill your Fish Diary, collect stars and earn permanent bonuses.
f_2_d: Upgrades in the workshop boost your stats for good, so every run makes the next one stronger.
f_3_d: Daily quests, endless achievements, a lucky wheel and a daily reward make every day a new adventure.
f_4_d: Gold Tide, Treasure Hunt and Bounty Hour events bring extra rewards.
f_5_d: No internet is needed to play, and your nets keep collecting gold even while you're away (offline earnings).
f_6_d: Free to download, with optional in-app purchases (gems, gold, a starter pack and ad removal), and available in more than 70 languages.
screens_desc: Sample screens from fishing, boss battles, weapons, zones, rare fish and pets.
